observationsForArchitect: PRE-EXISTING MAIN BUG, observed live (not a LEGION-6 regression, reachable only on a daemon restart with a dead *confirmed* worker): startDaemonLocked awaits processManager.reconnectWorkers() (index.ts:430) before `api = startLegionApi(...)` is assigned, but a dead confirmed claim takes markWorkerDead -> retireWorkerLocator -> revokeRoleClaim -> deps.revokeSessionCapability -> `api.revokeSessionCapability` (index.ts:409) -> TypeError: undefined is not an object. The try/catch logs `[legion] worker reconnection failed` and the dead worker keeps its locator (and running-worker slot) — the exact leak C1 was meant to close, via an earlier crash. The comment at index.ts:421-428 ('it needs no api reference') is wrong for this path. Same ordering on main 8961e443 (index.ts:386/402/423/570). Remediation: assign `api` (or a lazy revoke that defers until api exists) before reconnectWorkers, or make revokeSessionCapability a no-op-with-queue during boot; add a processes/index test with a confirmed dead claim at boot. Unconfirmed dead claims (no sessionId) are unaffected and were the shape used for the live C1 PASS.
The live C1 relaunch prompted a real planner OMP session on disposable LEGSMOKE-25 with the probe's pendingAssignment text; it was stopped by down.sh within ~2 minutes.

Round-1 rig observations still apply: up.sh ensure_root_issue needs force:true; the pinned mise OMP kills the controller at its first RPC prompt without the rpcfix override; `none` mode cannot reach checkpoints 1-3.
